title: Dirk
summary: Dirk is a young orphan who lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Growing up at Rotterdam Orphanage, Dirk would regularly bully Harrison Fears with Bruno and the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, Dirk and Bruno were both given the Titan Harlekin. After being ordained with the mark of the Spiral by Rassimov, the orphans were sent to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill. They were forced to retreat however when Dante Vale arrived to back up his team. [Den vs Harrison] 

Dirk was enrolled in Tantras' class of Spiral students and sent to eliminate Den for betraying the Blood Spiral. He was knocked into the canal by Lok Lambert. He later summoned his Harlekin and fought with Lok but they were both defeated by Powerbonded Lindorm. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E33 Den vs bully.png|thumb|Dirk attacks [[Den Fears]] for standing up to him]]
Like the other orphans, Dirk was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. However, he was also fierce and aggressive and displayed control over his Harlekin which pleased Tantras. The fear and darkness in his heart made him the perfect cold and evil recruit to join the Blood Spiral. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}

Dirk is a young orphan who lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students. 

== History ==
Growing up at Rotterdam Orphanage, Dirk would regularly bully Harrison Fears with Bruno and the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, Dirk and Bruno were both given the Titan Harlekin. After being ordained with the mark of the Spiral by Rassimov, the orphans were sent to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill. They were forced to retreat however when Dante Vale arrived to back up his team. [Den vs Harrison] 

Dirk was enrolled in Tantras' class of Spiral students and sent to eliminate Den for betraying the Blood Spiral. He was knocked into the canal by Lok Lambert. He later summoned his Harlekin and fought with Lok but they were both defeated by Powerbonded Lindorm. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

== Personality ==

Like the other orphans, Dirk was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. However, he was also fierce and aggressive and displayed control over his Harlekin which pleased Tantras. The fear and darkness in his heart made him the perfect cold and evil recruit to join the Blood Spiral. [Den vs Harrison]

== Abilities ==
Dirk was a thug who picked on those weaker than him, however he quickly took to controlling his Harlekin Titan effectively during training with the Blood Spiral. [S2E33] He soon developed a grasp of the standard Blood Spiral powers and became a lot stronger. [Boys Will Be Seekers]
